## Summary

Describe the change and its intended result.

## Motivation

What problem does this change address? Link the related issue or RFC.

## Risk

Describe operational, maintenance, or review risks and how they are mitigated.

## Test evidence

List the tests, checks, or manual validation you ran. Explain any validation
that was not run.

## Compatibility impact

Describe API, event, storage, configuration, or user-facing compatibility
effects. State "None" when there is no impact.

## Security and privacy impact

Describe effects on authorization, tenant isolation, secrets, personal data,
or other security and privacy boundaries. Do not include vulnerability details;
report vulnerabilities through the private process in SECURITY.md.

## Documentation impact

List documentation changes, or explain why none are needed.

## DCO confirmation

- [ ] Every commit in this pull request includes a DCO 1.1 sign-off created
      with `git commit -s`.

## AI-assistance disclosure

Describe any AI assistance used and the human review and validation performed.
